# 1 Clement Chapter 13 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 13 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_013_page_001.jpg

---

## Council Notes

Chapter 13 begins the second major section of the letter — the call to humility. It opens with two scripture citations: Jeremiah 9:23-24 (on not boasting in wisdom/strength/riches) and then a collection of sayings attributed to the Lord Jesus.

The Jesus-sayings in 13:2 are critically significant. They parallel Matt 5:7; 6:14-15; 7:1-2, 12; Luke 6:31, 36-38 — but in a compressed, balanced form unlike any canonical Gospel. The most likely explanation is that Clement is drawing on an independent oral tradition of Jesus' sayings, perhaps a catechetical collection, rather than copying from written Gospels. This makes ch. 13 a key witness to the transmission of Jesus' teaching.

The six sayings form a tight antithetical structure: show mercy → receive mercy; forgive → be forgiven; do → have done to you; give → receive; judge → be judged; show kindness → kindness shown; measure → measured.

---

## Chapter 13

**13:1** Therefore, brothers, let us be humble-minded, laying aside all arrogance and conceit and foolishness and anger, and let us do what is written. For the Holy Spirit says: "Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, nor the strong man in his strength, nor the rich man in his riches; but let him who boasts boast in the Lord, to seek him out and to do justice and righteousness" — above all being mindful of the words of the Lord Jesus, which he spoke when teaching gentleness and long-suffering. [Jer 9:23-24 LXX]

**13:2** For he spoke thus: "Show mercy, that you may receive mercy. Forgive, that you may be forgiven. As you do, so shall it be done to you. As you give, so shall it be given to you. As you judge, so shall you be judged. As you show kindness, so shall kindness be shown to you. With what measure you measure, with the same it shall be measured to you."

---

*SOPHIA consensus translation. Completed 2026-03-17.*
